messages:
Maya: Hey team — planning a staged traffic replay this Friday to validate KV cache behavior + look for perf regressions after the runtime patch. Need quick sync on owners and checks. Window: Fri 09:00-13:00 PT. :calendar:

Ashwin: I can drive the replay orchestration and k6 bursts. Need someone on runtime profiling and one on infra watching GPU/IO.

Leo: I'll own runtime profiling. I'll set up perf counters (nsys) and heap/disk traces. :eyes:

Sophie: I'll be infra on-call for the window — will watch node-level metrics, disk iops, and network. Add me to the schedule.

Maya: Thanks. @Ashwin can you post the exact k6/locust commands you'll run? Also we should do a small warmup then the full replay.

Ashwin: plan:
1) Warmup 15m (10% traffic) to populate KV caches.
2) Staged ramp 30m up to target QPS.
3) 60m sustained soak at target.
4) Cooldown 15m.

k6 snippet:
```
k6 run --vus 100 --duration 60m replay-script.js --out influxdb=http://influx:8086/mydb
```
Locust (for session-y flows):
```
locust -f replay_locustfile.py --users 200 --spawn-rate 20 --headless -t 60m
```

Maya: Perfect. For regression checks we want:
- 95th/99th latency per route before/after
- CPU/GPU utilization, host load
- KV hit ratio and eviction rate
- Token generation latency tail (if applicable)
- Any error spike or 5xx trends

Tor: I'll collect the pre-run baseline metrics and upload dashboards. Where do we store the replay dataset? Remember PII removal.

Ashwin: Dataset is in s3://replays/2026-03-07-prod-anon/ — already scrubbed. I'll share replay mapping to routes.

Jin: Quick ask — can we enable additional tracing on the canary model variant? Want to see fallback rates.

Maya: Yes — add header X-RW-EXP=canary to 10% of requests during ramp. Track fallback_count metric.

Sophie: One more: let's gate the full soak on a smoke run result. If any route has >1% 5xx or 2x baseline p99 in smoke, abort.

Ashwin: I'll wire an automated smoke gate check and post a pass/fail webhook to the channel. If fail, it will stop the replay job.

locust-bot: replay-job-875 started (warmup). Logs -> http://logs.internal/replay/875 :robot_face:

Leo: Initial warmup perf looks fine. KV hit ratio rising as expected. Sharing flamegraphs in 10m.

Maya: Who's doing post-mortem notes? Want a short doc with: setup, checks, anomalies, mitigation steps.

Tor: I'll draft the post-run notes and link them here.

Ashwin: tagging checklist for execution:
- [x] warmup script
- [ ] smoke gate automation
- [x] perf traces collection
- [x] replay dataset validation
- [x] rollback playbook ready

Sophie: On-call schedule updated. My paging escalation is set to PagerDuty team-runtime.

Maya: Great. If anyone spots an odd tail latency spike during warmup ping here with screenshot + trace id. :thumbsup:

Jin: I'll keep an eye on fallback_count and model-serving errors. Good to go from me.

locust-bot: replay-job-875 moved to staged ramp. Current QPS 12k. Logs -> http://logs.internal/replay/875

Leo: Flamegraphs uploaded: http://grafana/internal/flame/replay-875

Maya: Thanks all — will start the formal runbook at 08:45 PT and kick off at 09:00. Ping here for quick async updates during the run.
